title: openRMS Rigs settings profile, v1
description: Settings for one radio model and one operation. YAML and JSON are two serializations of the same document. Values use Hamlib names and Hamlib units exactly as `rigctl --dump-caps` prints them (RFPOWER is a 0..1 fraction, not watts). See profile.md.

hamlib_model.description: rigctld -m N, as of the tested Hamlib version.

mfg.description: Manufacturer as dump_caps prints it ("Mfg name").

name.description: Model as dump_caps prints it ("Model name").

interface.description: External audio/CAT interface, if any (e.g. "built-in USB codec", "SignaLink USB").

hamlib.description: Hamlib versions this profile was tested with.

audio.description: Targets a client can measure when a level can't be set over CAT.

rx_target_dbfs.description: Receive audio noise floor target at the computer, in dBFS (e.g. -25).

app.description: e.g. wsjt-x, fldigi, pat, ardopcf, pipewire

id.description: Unique within the profile; check results refer to it.

name.description: Hamlib name for level/func/parm (exactly as dump_caps prints it), "MODE" for mode, a short label for cat/manual.

value.description: Target value in Hamlib units. mode: a Hamlib mode name (PKTUSB). func: true/false. cat: the raw value inserted into cat.set.

expect.description: Acceptable values for a check. Absent means the target value exactly (within one Hamlib step for levels).

not.description: Values that are a problem, e.g. AGC OFF.

check_only.description: Verify and warn, but never set (e.g. 'AGC must not be OFF').

safety.description: tx = changes transmit behaviour (power, mic gain, mod source); clients ask the operator first. The server raises this to tx when it knows better. Steps that can key the transmitter are rejected outright.

unit.description: Informational; Hamlib's unit for the name (fraction, dB, Hz, wpm, enum...).

display.description: Human reading of the value, e.g. "~35 W".

hamlib.description: Hamlib versions this step needs, if narrower than the profile.

firmware.description: Firmware or menu-table versions this step applies to.

menu.description: Menu path on the radio, e.g. "MENU > SET > Connectors > USB MOD Level".

cat.description: Raw CAT through rigctld's send_cmd, for menu items Hamlib lacks. Limited to an allow-list of settings command families (profile.md); checked on the rendered command.

protocol.description: ascii: Kenwood/Yaesu/Elecraft style text ending in ';'. civ: Icom CI-V body as hex bytes, without preamble, addresses or FD (the client frames it for its radio address).

read.description: Command that reads the current value, e.g. "EX010413;".

reply.description: Regex for the reply; capture group 1 is the value. e.g. "^EX010413(\\d{3});$".

set.description: Template; {value} or {value:03} (zero-padded width) is replaced. e.g. "EX010413{value:03};".
